notes: Seed tier lists from Steam community guides for single finishes and phases.
Tiers: T1 is the most valuable. Tiers are kept while a group's cumulative seed count stays within 100 (T1 always kept); lower published tiers are omitted as not notable.
Seed tiers are data from the Steam community guides credited in the repository README; the repository is MIT licensed.
Groups with paintIndexes only apply to those paint kits (Doppler and Gamma Doppler phases).
Doppler and Gamma Doppler phases by paint kit id, per weapon.
Tiers: T1 gems (Ruby, Sapphire, Black Pearl, Emerald; kept tied because sources dispute their order), T2 Phase 2 (priciest numbered phase),
T3 Butterfly Knife Doppler Phase 4 (the article names it as the one numbered phase with its own premium). Phases 1 and 3 get no tier.
Butterfly Knife and Shadow Daggers use their own paint kit ids for Black Pearl (617), Phase 2 (618) and Sapphire (619).
